name: launch_girder_v3
description:
Launched-girder carriage for gap L3 (752 mm), v2: rigid ladder girder.

Carriage (heavy, all electrics) on 4 driven wheels; a 968 mm girder slides over its roof in rack guides.
The girder is a ladder of two axle chords through 21 axle-connectors (cross fits: one rigid body), with
beam bricks pinned along one side carrying plates and the 22-rack bar. The carriage carries the girder on
two free rollers under the bricks and holds it down with the rack pinion between them.
  phase 1: drive with the girder cantilevered ahead until its nose wheel lands on the far deck;
  phase 2: keep driving (dragging the girder) until the rear wheels run off the near edge, then the rack motor runs
           the carriage 692 mm along the girder (now a bridge) to the front stop; the front wheels land on the far deck;
  phase 3: keep driving, dragging the girder off the near deck behind the carriage.

motor_program.note: rear wheels off the near edge: run the carriage along the girder to the front stop
wheels in the air: let the gear row turn freely
front wheels reach the far deck: drive on
